items.description: The Abios Desktop Stream Viewer Mashup is a Qt5 application that uses streamlink and libVLC callbacks to play live video streams. It allows users to access streamlink API’s stream data and libVLC API’s full coverage.
For history buffs and school kids, a mashup showing where presidents/first ladies were born. From George Washington through George Bush.
Lost your phone? Punch in your number and we'll call it for you.
A small Google Maps Mashup displays the weather forecast and weather-tweets in a nice, simple style.

PDXCouncilConnect is a service of the Portland, Oregon, eGovPDX group. The city technology department makes the API available to access city council agenda and voting information. The PDXCouncilConnect API provides developers access to agenda, session, and item information. The data includes the location and time, as well as bureaus affected. When a vote occurs, the API also will return voting information.This government API has a RESTful interface and provides data as JSON.

The CoinDesk & Guardian News mashup merges Bitcoin prices and Guardian news headlines, showing them visually in a timeline. CoinDesk is a news site specializing in bitcoin and digital currencies. The Guardian is a British daily newspaper.
mybill.is is a social media payments system. Connects social media networks with payment systems to quickly and easily create bills and manage them on the go.

Savings.com brings you the best deals on all the things you want, making it easier than ever to search, find and share big savings from all your favorite brands and stores. Local deals are provided by Groupon and 8coupons.
A free resource for viewing, sharing, mixing and mashing maps online. Created by the UCL Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis, you can select any number of maps to overlay and view.

CallCollector is a virtual voicemail box to collect calls from fans, customers, groups, or whatever you need it for. A business may use it as a complaint & feedback line. A talk radio station may use it to allow listeners to vent to (or about) their on-air personalities. You might even use it to collect wishes from family all over the county and stitch them together for a relative's birthday or anniversary.
Cheapflights-to.net is a travel tools for buying airline tickets to destinations, package holidays, special deals for hotels and car rentals.
Run your own shop with this store in a box. Powered by the Commission Junction API gives it millions of products.
This mashup uses the Amazon API to give reviews and ratings on thousands of products organized into handy categories ranging from computers, electronics and home goods.

The Google Book Search Book Viewability API enables developers to: Link to Books in Google Book Search using ISBNs, LCCNs, and OCLC numbers; Know whether Google Book Search has a specific title and what the viewability of that title is; Generate links to a thumbnail of the cover of a book; Generate links to an informational page about a book; Generate links to a preview of a book.
View locations made famous in the Seinfeld sitcom. Includes the Soup Nazi, the Diner, and Nathans Coney Island.
A Google Gadget for website builders. Internet and Web terms, facts, history, events, and knowledge plus everyday tips and advice for building a website, blog or e-commerce site.
Search, rate, and discuss skate spots, parks and shops in your neighborhood using Google Maps. Upload, watch and rate your favorite skate videos and photos.
A map of the most expensive stadiums around the world.
See where the latest news is happening in the UK.

Your application can use the Mobile Phone Megastore API to search for mobile phones. Partners and other developers can then publish this information on their websites.The main benefits of the mobile phone API Web Service is that you can access just the data you require without downloading the entire product database. This allows you to easily publish the data on your website needing to separately process the XML.

The Neto application programmer interface enables third party software to interact with the Neto E-commerce Suite. Requests can be made in XML or JSON and returns Categories, Warehouses, Customers and more. Neto is an all-in-one hosted ecommerce software solution based in Australia.
